name: Dependency source guard
summary: Reject newly introduced dependencies that bypass an authenticated package registry.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that reconstructs supported dependency manifest edits and blocks net-new Git, URL, local-path, alias, or dynamically resolved package sources while allowing ordinary registry constraints.
risk_reason: This automatic gate rejects newly introduced dependencies that bypass an authenticated package registry; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not install, resolve, upgrade, audit, or select dependency versions.
It does not contact a registry, Git server, archive host, or local package directory.
It does not claim that registry-resolved packages are safe, authentic, or compatible.
It does not expose an inline suppression or project-controlled source allowlist.

entrypoints.purpose: Inspect bounded dependency manifest changes and reject net-new package sources that bypass ordinary registry resolution.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to reject newly introduced dependencies that bypass an authenticated package registry without deferred work.
